title: HRFlow
tagline: HRMS workflow engine with approvals, RBAC & audit trail
highlights: Spring Boot 3 HRMS engine with data-driven multi-level approval workflows across 3 request types, JWT auth and service-layer RBAC over 16 REST endpoints.
Append-only audit trail and a per-country leave-rule engine (India/UAE/Germany), covered by 27 Java tests on embedded Postgres plus 4 Python tests.
HMAC-SHA256 signed payroll webhooks with retries + delivery log, and an idempotent CSV employee importer with row-level validation.
Seeds its 1,470-employee population from the real public IBM HR Attrition dataset (Kaggle, DbCL-1.0) with no fabricated attributes; approval/audit events are app-generated at runtime.
